frozen: HYPOTHESIS.md hash table, 'Manifest rule' = tasks/selection_rules.json + tasks/build_manifests.py
order_rule: a pool's ids are sorted ascending by the hex sha256 of 'exp036|<pool>|<seed>|<id>' (UTF-8); a selection of n takes a prefix
rgb_seed_rule: RGB's evalue.py calls random.seed(2333) before processdata for every instance; reproduced per item with random.Random(2333); the chosen document indices are written to the manifest and the run host renders from them

hash_rules.item_sha256: sha256 of canonical_json of the source fields the loader reads (see each tasks/<set>.py)
hash_rules.prompt_sha256: sha256 of canonical_json of the message list [{'role', 'content'}, ...] before any chat template

rgb_cb.label: R
rgb_cb.prompt: RGB instruction.yaml, passage_num 0, no system message

rgb_fact.label: R
rgb_fact.prompt: RGB system + instruction.yaml, positive_wrong passages (instruction_fact.yaml absent at the pin)

diamond_en.primary_rule: drop the row with sha256(Question, UTF-8) == vendored gpqa.py _OVERLONG_QUESTION_SHA256 (exactly one)

diamond_de.id_rule: first of ['Record ID', 'record_id', 'id', 'question_id', 'original_id'] present and non-empty in every row, else the 0-based row index; recorded as id_source

pilot_en.exclude: Record ID in gpqa_diamond.csv; the over-long question

pilot_de.exclude: ids that are Diamond Record IDs

mmlu_prox.categories_source: vendored mmlu_pro.py MMLU_PRO_SUBJECTS (14, English names; a DE row takes the EN category of the same question_id)
mmlu_prox.nM_rule: n_M/14 ids per category = a prefix of that category's order; listed interleaved by rank (rank 0 of every category in subject order, then rank 1, ...)
mmlu_prox.options_rule: options = 'options' list, or option_0..option_9 in order; trailing null, empty or 'N/A' options are dropped; answer_index must index the options and agree with the 'answer' letter
mmlu_prox.full_pool_rule: ids of the full test split present in en and de, not in Lite (ids of either language) and whose normalised EN question is not a Lite EN question
mmlu_prox.category_counts: full test split, per language, per (English) category

aime.id_rule: first of ['id', 'problem_id', 'ID'] present in every row, else the 0-based row index

fact.prompt: config/instruction.yaml (system + instruction): RGB's README procedure for counterfactual robustness; config/instruction_fact.yaml does not exist at 65ec39e4

pilot.forced_rule: the first 8 of the 16 closed-book pilot items

rgb.known_limitation: RGB also ships data/en_refine.json (2024-03 refined documents and answers); the pre-registration uses en.json

pilot.rule: HYPOTHESIS 'Pilot': per arm, task-grouped, at the memory-rule B and the initial caps; never scored for accuracy

gate.t9_continues_from: the documents after T6 at index >= 5000, in file order

shingles.rule: tools/shingles.py write_shingle_file (the leak check's own normalisation: NFKC, lower-case, characters that are neither letters, digits nor whitespace removed, whitespace collapsed); 8-word shingles as 12-hex sha256 prefixes; the full sha256 of every normalised option string of >= 3 words that is not a generic phrase
sources: GPQA EN questions and options (options also as option hashes), gpqa_diamond.csv and gpqa_main.csv
German GPQA questions and options (options also as option hashes), every row of the deu config
RGB queries and answers (en, en_fact, en_int)
RGB instruction.yaml system and instruction strings (the instruction also as an option hash)
